mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the nursery outflow with the cold cloud was most worthwhile: it connected the earlier clearing to a new episode of star formation.

leastWorthwhile.text: The disk material joining the cold cloud was straightforward and less surprising than the other encounters, though it clearly completed its goal.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; each pairing followed the chapter's description or its goals.

continue.text: I would continue: the connections between earlier outflows and later star formation make me curious about where the material goes next.
